title: Try something new for 30 days | Matt Cutts
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】嘗試新事物 30 天 |馬特卡茨（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: A few years ago, I felt like I was stuck in a rut,
cues.en: A few years ago, I felt like I was stuck in a rut,
cues.zh: 幾年前，我感覺自己陷入了困境，

cues.text: so I decided to follow in the footsteps of the great American philosopher, Morgan Spurlock,
cues.en: so I decided to follow in the footsteps of the great American philosopher, Morgan Spurlock,
cues.zh: 所以我決定跟隨偉大的美國哲學家摩根·斯普爾洛克的腳步，

cues.text: and try something new for 30 days.
cues.en: and try something new for 30 days.
cues.zh: 並嘗試新事物 30 天。

cues.text: The idea is actually pretty simple.
cues.en: The idea is actually pretty simple.
cues.zh: 這個想法其實非常簡單。

cues.text: Think about something you've always wanted to add to your life and try it for the next 30 days.
cues.en: Think about something you've always wanted to add to your life and try it for the next 30 days.
cues.zh: 想想你一直想為你的生活新增些什麼，並在接下來的 30 天裡嘗試。

cues.text: It turns out 30 days is just about the right amount of time to add a new habit or subtract a habit --
cues.en: It turns out 30 days is just about the right amount of time to add a new habit or subtract a habit --
cues.zh: 事實證明，30 天正好是增加一個新習慣或減少一個習慣的適當時機——

cues.text: like watching the news -- from your life.
cues.en: like watching the news -- from your life.
cues.zh: 就像看新聞－來自你的生活。

cues.text: There's a few things I learned while doing these 30-day challenges.
cues.en: There's a few things I learned while doing these 30-day challenges.
cues.zh: 在進行這 30 天的挑戰時，我學到了一些東西。

cues.text: The first was, instead of the months flying by, forgotten,
cues.en: The first was, instead of the months flying by, forgotten,
cues.zh: 第一個是，幾個月的時間飛逝而過，卻被遺忘了，

cues.text: the time was much more memorable.
cues.en: the time was much more memorable.
cues.zh: 那段時光更加令人難忘。

cues.text: This was part of a challenge I did to take a picture every day for a month.
cues.en: This was part of a challenge I did to take a picture every day for a month.
cues.zh: 這是我在一個月內每天拍照的挑戰的一部分。

cues.text: And I remember exactly where I was and what I was doing that day.
cues.en: And I remember exactly where I was and what I was doing that day.
cues.zh: 我清楚地記得那天我在哪裡以及我在做什麼。

cues.text: I also noticed that as I started to do more and harder 30-day challenges,
cues.en: I also noticed that as I started to do more and harder 30-day challenges,
cues.zh: 我還注意到，當我開始進行更多、更難的 30 天挑戰時，

cues.text: my self-confidence grew.
cues.en: my self-confidence grew.
cues.zh: 我的自信心增強了。

cues.text: I went from desk-dwelling computer nerd to the kind of guy who bikes to work.
cues.en: I went from desk-dwelling computer nerd to the kind of guy who bikes to work.
cues.zh: 我從坐在辦公桌前的電腦迷變成了騎腳踏車上班的人。

cues.text: For fun!
cues.en: For fun!
cues.zh: 為了好玩！

cues.text: Even last year, I ended up hiking up Mt. Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa.
cues.en: Even last year, I ended up hiking up Mt. Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa.
cues.zh: 甚至去年，我就徒步登上了非洲最高峰乞力馬扎羅山。

cues.text: I would never have been that adventurous before I started my 30-day challenges.
cues.en: I would never have been that adventurous before I started my 30-day challenges.
cues.zh: 在開始 30 天的挑戰之前，我絕對不會如此富有冒險精神。

cues.text: I also figured out that if you really want something badly enough,
cues.en: I also figured out that if you really want something badly enough,
cues.zh: 我還發現，如果你真的很想要某樣東西，

cues.text: you can do anything for 30 days.
cues.en: you can do anything for 30 days.
cues.zh: 30天內你可以做任何事。

cues.text: Have you ever wanted to write a novel?
cues.en: Have you ever wanted to write a novel?
cues.zh: 你曾經想寫一本小說嗎？

cues.text: Every November, tens of thousands of people try to write their own 50,000-word novel, from scratch,
cues.en: Every November, tens of thousands of people try to write their own 50,000-word novel, from scratch,
cues.zh: 每年11月，成千上萬的人嘗試從頭開始寫自己的五萬字小說，

cues.text: in 30 days.
cues.en: in 30 days.
cues.zh: 30天內。

cues.text: It turns out, all you have to do is write 1,667 words a day
cues.en: It turns out, all you have to do is write 1,667 words a day
cues.zh: 事實證明，你所要做的就是每天寫 1,667 個字

cues.text: for a month.
cues.en: for a month.
cues.zh: 一個月。

cues.text: So I did.
cues.en: So I did.
cues.zh: 所以我做到了。

cues.text: By the way, the secret is not to go to sleep until you've written your words for the day.
cues.en: By the way, the secret is not to go to sleep until you've written your words for the day.
cues.zh: 順便說一句，秘訣就是在寫下當天的內容之前不要睡覺。

cues.text: You might be sleep-deprived, but you'll finish your novel.
cues.en: You might be sleep-deprived, but you'll finish your novel.
cues.zh: 你可能睡眠不足，但你會完成你的小說。

cues.text: Now is my book the next great American novel?
cues.en: Now is my book the next great American novel?
cues.zh: 現在我的書會是下一部偉大的美國小說嗎？

cues.text: No. I wrote it in a month.
cues.en: No. I wrote it in a month.
cues.zh: 不，我花了一個月的時間寫的。

cues.text: It's awful.
cues.en: It's awful.
cues.zh: 太糟糕了。

cues.text: But for the rest of my life, if I meet John Hodgman at a TED party,
cues.en: But for the rest of my life, if I meet John Hodgman at a TED party,
cues.zh: 但在我的餘生中，如果我在 TED 聚會上遇到約翰·霍奇曼，

cues.text: I don't have to say, "I'm a computer scientist."
cues.en: I don't have to say, "I'm a computer scientist."
cues.zh: 我不必說：“我是一名電腦科學家。”

cues.text: No, if I want to, I can say, "I'm a novelist." So here's one last thing I'd like to mention.
cues.en: No, if I want to, I can say, "I'm a novelist." So here's one last thing I'd like to mention.
cues.zh: 不，如果我願意，我可以說：「我是小說家。」這是我想提的最後一件事。

cues.text: I learned that when I made small, sustainable changes, things I could keep doing,
cues.en: I learned that when I made small, sustainable changes, things I could keep doing,
cues.zh: 我瞭解到，當我做出小的、可持續的改變時，我可以繼續做一些事情，

cues.text: they were more likely to stick.
cues.en: they were more likely to stick.
cues.zh: 他們更有可能堅持下去。

cues.text: There's nothing wrong with big, crazy challenges.
cues.en: There's nothing wrong with big, crazy challenges.
cues.zh: 巨大而瘋狂的挑戰並沒有什麼不好。

cues.text: In fact, they're a ton of fun.
cues.en: In fact, they're a ton of fun.
cues.zh: 事實上，它們非常有趣。

cues.text: But they're less likely to stick.
cues.en: But they're less likely to stick.
cues.zh: 但他們不太可能堅持下去。

cues.text: When I gave up sugar for 30 days, day 31 looked like this.
cues.en: When I gave up sugar for 30 days, day 31 looked like this.
cues.zh: 當我戒糖 30 天時，第 31 天是這樣的。

cues.text: So here's my question to you: What are you waiting for?
cues.en: So here's my question to you: What are you waiting for?
cues.zh: 所以這是我問你的問題：你還在等什麼？

cues.text: I guarantee you the next 30 days are going to pass whether you like it or not,
cues.en: I guarantee you the next 30 days are going to pass whether you like it or not,
cues.zh: 我向你保證，不管你喜不喜歡，接下來的30天都會過去，

cues.text: so why not think about something you have always wanted to try
cues.en: so why not think about something you have always wanted to try
cues.zh: 那為什麼不想想你一直想嘗試的事情呢

cues.text: and give it a shot!
cues.en: and give it a shot!
cues.zh: 並試一試！

cues.text: For the next 30 days.
cues.en: For the next 30 days.
cues.zh: 接下來的 30 天。

cues.text: Thanks.
cues.en: Thanks.
cues.zh: 謝謝。
